metadata.method_name: Boiling point vs altitude: 2x2 factorial of atmosphere model and thermodynamic model
metadata.description: Four variants of water boiling point vs altitude (0-9 km): V1 isothermal + constant-enthalpy Clausius-Clapeyron; V2 isothermal + IAPWS-IF97 saturation; V3 ISA lapse-rate + constant-enthalpy; V4 ISA lapse-rate + IAPWS-IF97. Residuals (model minus Engineering ToolBox table, K) reported by band. No measured pairs could be verified; measured comparison is empty.
metadata.baseline: V1 (isothermal + constant enthalpy) is the textbook shortcut; V2-V4 compared against it
metadata.benchmark: Engineering ToolBox table (method unstated; a reference curve, not a measurement)
metadata.notes: Band statistics and crossover results are in results/summary_by_band.json. No statistical test is performed.

datasets.dataset: Engineering ToolBox boiling point vs altitude table (0-9 km)
